title: Korallen-DHW-Sandbox — NOAA Degree Heating Week bleaching sandbox
description: Interactive NOAA Coral Reef Watch Degree Heating Week (DHW) bleaching sandbox, using published constants from GenesisAeon's coral-reef-utac (P114): DHW 0–20 °C-weeks with five alert levels (4/8/12/16/20), four global bleaching events (21% → 37% → 68% → 83.7% of reef area), Hughes et al. 2018 6-year return interval, GCRMN & ICRI Status 2025 5–6 year recovery window (DOI 10.59387/LFPR6347), Guillermic et al. 2021 heat/acidification synergy, and Walker et al. 2023 genotype honesty check. No UTAC/CREP/AFET bridge and no invented Gamma value. Part of the GenesisAeon interactive-sandbox series.
